name: Chapuchapu
source: A Chapuchapu type monster girl. She's a swimming type monster girl (Chapuchapu means splish-splash) and [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] finds this Chapuchapu at the beach. This Chapuchapu is incredibly creepy, she just wants to kill herself already but Leo won't let her commit suicide so she's often depressed. She enjoys bondage sex and being tortured.
